SELECT resource_type_general, count(*) AS records FROM govblock_scholarly.zenodo_records GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many urologists are enrolled in Medicare?
SELECT count(DISTINCT npi) AS clinicians FROM govblock_health.cc_dac_nationaldownloadablefile WHERE pri_spec = 'UROLOGY'
Which European countries get the most out of their onshore wind on average?
SELECT country, avg(try_cast(cf AS double)) AS avg_capacity_factor FROM govblock_energy.wind_entsoe_pecd_pecd_country_onshore GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many organisations are listed as PubChem data sources?
Which counties in California have the highest median home values?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS median_value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 AS a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_5yr AS g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0500000US06%' AND a.variable = 'B25077_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Democrats and Republicans sit in New York's legislature?
SELECT party, count(*) AS members FROM govblock_geo.legislature_members WHERE state_file LIKE 'ny-%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which plumbing and heating contractors earned the most from federal work on Long Island since 2020?

SELECT recipient_name, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE naics_code = '238220' AND primary_place_of_performance_state_code = 'NY' AND upper(primary_place_of_performance_county_name) IN ('NASSAU', 'SUFFOLK') AND action_date_fiscal_year >= '2020' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many toxic-release reporting facilities are in Harris County, Texas?
SELECT count(DISTINCT _2_trifd) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.tri_basic WHERE _7_county = 'HARRIS' AND _8_st = 'TX'
Which tissues or body fluids are named most often as where ChEBI compounds were found?
SELECT component_text, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chebi_compound_origins WHERE component_text IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many judges were confirmed by the Senate in 2014?
SELECT count(*) AS confirmations FROM govblock_courts.people_db_positions WHERE substr(cast(date_confirmation AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2014'
Which agencies had the most economically significant rules in the works in fall 2023?

SELECT name, count(DISTINCT rin) AS rules FROM govblock_executive.oira_unified_agenda WHERE publication_id = '202310' AND priority_category LIKE 'Economically Significant%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many people living in Queens were born outside the United States?
SELECT value FROM govblock_census.acs5_2024 WHERE geo_id = '0500000US36081' AND variable = 'B05002_E013'
Where has formal Clean Water Act enforcement been heaviest, state by state?
SELECT substr(npdes_id, 1, 2) AS state, count(*) AS actions FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_formal_enforcement_actions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many PubChem bioassays are tied to humans (taxonomy 9606)?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_bioassay_aid2taxid WHERE taxid = 9606
Which enzyme numbers are linked to the most Rhea reactions?
SELECT id, count(DISTINCT rhea_id) AS reactions FROM govblock_chemistry.rhea_rhea2ec WHERE id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
